change.why: Check, Recover, Prestart and Watch modes: paired rename of Docker's run and docker-secrets-engine folders with rollback, one Desktop start, engine and demo container waits, JSONL run log
per-user Scheduled Tasks for the logon (-Prestart) and 5-minute (-Watch) runs; -Status reads Docker's AutoStart key only
node --test running the real script on a fake root with a stub docker .cmd and -DryRun for process stop/start; text check of the never list

reuse: the demo container prefix ulpin-demo- and the docker CLI as scripts/platform/runtime.mjs uses it; no new service; nothing in apps or packages changes
testSeams: -Root, -DockerExe, -DesktopExe, -DryRun as the task names; also -OpsDir (log and state folder), -RecheckSeconds and -WaitSeconds (short waits in tests) and -Stamp (a fixed aside suffix so a test can make the target exist)
runtime: real machine: -Check and -Status (read only) only; never -Recover, -Prestart or -Install
